To evaluate the quality of the generated answers, we use the F1-score  as the primary metric, which is the harmonic mean of precision and recall. Additionally, we employ ROUGE-L , based on n-gram matching with the reference, to measure the similarity between the generated answers and the reference answers. We also utilize the Exact Match (EM) score as supplementary indicator to assess the accuracy of generated answers. To evaluate the preciseness of selecting evidence paragraphs corresponding to answers to queries, we use Accuracy (%).
